title: IRDAI Partners with IPAI to Eliminate Dark Patterns in Insurance Sector
summary: Partners with Institute of Public Auditors of India to curb misselling on digital insurance portals.

blocks.text: 🪝 IRDAI Partners with IPAI to Eliminate Dark Patterns in Insurance Sector. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Partners with Institute of Public Auditors of India to curb misselling on digital insurance portals.
Regulatory Objective: Monitors dark patterns and forced add-on sales on digital insurance apps.
Implementation Alignment: Follows RBI's anti-misselling framework effective January 1, 2027.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
